blockingFindings.description: Direct V215 crouch and sit renders show no visible lap-coverage improvement over V214. The inner layer covers both thighs nearly to the knees, while the outer apron folds beside and between them; the lilac hem forms sharp points below the knees and leaves the lap uncovered.
Standing profiles still show a mid-thigh bend and forward hem projection. Prone still doubles the front fabric beneath the hips, with several folds under the near hand.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
